title: Zone lengths after a rightward cascade
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number, let $j<\ell$, and let $z$ be zone contents with $\ell$ levels. Suppose the right words at all levels $k<j$ are empty, the left words at those levels fill their zones to capacity, the right word at level $j$ has length at least $2^j$, and the left word at level $j$ has room for at least $2^j$ additional symbols. After the rightward cascade through $j$ levels, each level $k<j$ has left and right word lengths both equal to $2^k$; at level $j$, the right word's length is its original length minus $2^j$, and the left word's length is its original length plus $2^j$.
